name: max-game
description: Max's Overworld - a browser overworld game

scripts.build:site: npm run typecheck && npm run check:dialogues && node scripts/test-content-refresh.mjs && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-site.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:dialogues && npm test && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: npm run clean:dist && esbuild js/core/main.ts js/interiors/internal.ts js/characters/niall/niall-fight.ts js/core/transform.ts --bundle --minify --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife && node scripts/stamp-web-entrypoints.mjs
scripts.generate:typescript: npm run generate:dialogues && npm run generate:profiles && npm run generate:dialogue-themes && npm run generate:internal-collision && node scripts/generate-ghost-sprite.mjs && node scripts/refresh-web-assets.mjs && npm run generate:battle-avatars
scripts.watch: npm run generate:source && npm run clean:dist && esbuild js/core/main.ts js/interiors/internal.ts js/characters/niall/niall-fight.ts js/core/transform.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife --watch
scripts.test: node scripts/test-content-refresh.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && node scripts/check-web-performance.mjs
